title: Complete interactive REPL parity and status transition history log

sections.what: Add project switching, set/check-all, link/unlink, preview, tags, and roadmap commands to interactive mode, plus append lightweight status transition entries on task updates.
sections.why: interactive.py currently exposes only basic list/next/show/add/move/invalidate commands, and status moves only overwrite the updated date instead of leaving an audit trail.
sections.how: Extend interactive.py command loop via service helpers and optionally record compact status history entries in TaskRecord.
sections.verify: Run pytest tests/test_cli_and_mcp.py and exercise interactive commands.

acceptance.text: Interactive loop supports project, set, link, unlink, preview, tags, and roadmap
Status moves append timestamped transition history when enabled

evidence: Extended interactive.py REPL with project, set, check-all, link, unlink, preview, tags, roadmap, and help commands (with Windows-safe shlex splitting).
Added TaskRecord.history field in models.py, schema.py, and timestamped status transition logging in service.move_task.
